recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; the current source preserves the draft-questionnaire behavior requested by FHIR-32525 while using the valid status from the later FHIR-43667 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-32525 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking that draft questionnaires be allowed to contain a group item without child items. The voted resolution split the old que-1 error into an error for group items without children when the Questionnaire was complete, a warning that groups should have items, and an error that display items cannot have child items.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commits 520d040e6a00c79ed674439f077bdd3bcc261776 and 2bbb1b812ec2ed83d43c4bded1b1c84b809ce58b applied FHIR-32525 by replacing the single que-1 invariant in source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml with que-1a, que-1b, and que-1c and adding those conditions to Questionnaire.item.
additional_context: The original FHIR-32525 resolution used %resource.status='complete', but Questionnaire.status does not have a complete code. Later Applied/Persuasive issue FHIR-43667 stated that complete is a QuestionnaireResponse status and that que-1a should use Questionnaire status active instead. Commit 5fa59a80deca6414b4dbd79a5a21941c537e1a13 made that source correction, and combined-branch commit ec8545fa2377e7fb04429ec211d5f6fbcef76f62 already audits FHIR-43667.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scoped Questionnaire StructureDefinition has que-1a as an active-only error, que-1b as the general group warning, and que-1c as the display-child error, so no source edit is needed for FHIR-32525.
